description: Mouse Pad: turns mouse movement into CV while a chosen combination of modifier keys is held, with no need to point at the module

params.text: Adds that modifier key to the combination that starts tracking, Alt being Option on a Mac; at least one of the three must be lit, and tracking stops when any key of the combination is released
Off, tracking runs only while the key combination is held; on, one press of the combination starts tracking and the next press stops it
Scales how far that axis output moves for a given mouse movement, and inverts it below zero; at 100% the full width or height of the Rack window covers 10V
Sets where in the Rack window that axis reads 0V: 0% at the left or bottom edge, 100% at the right or top, 50% at the centre
On, that axis output follows where the pointer is in the window; off, it follows only the movement made since tracking started
On, that axis output returns to 0V when the keys are released; off, it holds its last value until tracking starts again

outputs.text: 10V while the mouse is being tracked and 0V while it is not, monophonic
Follows horizontal mouse movement, covering 10V with the X scale at 100%, monophonic
Follows vertical mouse movement, covering 10V with the Y scale at 100%, monophonic

notes: the three outputs stay at 0V while none of SHIFT, CTRL and ALT is lit, and tracking starts only while exactly the lit combination is held down with the Rack window focused
